comment.body: Thanks for the suggestion. This asks to replace or relocate Windows task switching and taskbar shell behavior rather than extend a bounded PowerToys surface. The closely related taskbar-location request #25124 was closed with the resolution to file it through Feedback Hub, where the Windows shell team can evaluate it. Please submit this side task-switcher concept there and include the desired interaction and layout.
